name: secdev
description: Your agent says it's secure. secdev makes it show the file:line. A P0/P1/P2 security checklist (OWASP ASVS 5.0, API Top 10 2023, MASVS 2.1) for Firebase, Supabase, Expo, Tauri and Electron apps, plus a CI security gate (gitleaks, osv-scanner, Semgrep) and a fix skill that re-verifies its own fixes.
